== Biography ==
Robert was born in 1832.  He died in the Battle of Belmont in the  Civil War, on 8 Nov 1861.<ref>IFaris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p. 77</ref>
